# MCP project references

- MCP TypeScript SDK v2: https://ts.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/v2/
- Official SDK source and examples: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk
- MCP Apps specification and bridge: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/extensions/apps/overview
- OpenAI ChatGPT MCP Apps UI guide: https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/chatgpt-ui/
- OpenAI custom MCP auth guide: https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/auth/

Use the official `@modelcontextprotocol/server`, `@modelcontextprotocol/client`, and `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` packages. Keep all CRM data access scoped to the authenticated subject except in explicitly enabled synthetic demo mode.
